'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Josh Mack DS Same As Day 1''' is the Dark Side decklist sheet turned in by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

The sheet reads '''Same As Day 1''' and lists no cards. No Day 1 decklist PDF is available, so the Day 1 list is not known and is not reconstructed here.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' unknown (sheet reads ''Same As Day 1'')
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

== Decklist ==

''Not listed: the sheet says "Same As Day 1". No Day 1 decklist is available.''
